title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen?
 Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema.
 Warum diese Rolle Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf.
 Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben.
 Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden.
 Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt.
 Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows.
 Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen.
 Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche.
 Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment.
 Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.
 Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten.
 Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert.

description:

  • Set up and manage dbt projects to ensure that the codebase is stable, scalable, and maintainable, adhering to best practices for long-term success.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job title: Senior Data Engineer
 Department: Data team
 Reports to: Lead Data Engineer
 Location: Paris, France
 Contract: Permanent, local and full-time
 Starting date: ASAP 2026
 PUR Description
 PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects.
 Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries.
 We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods.
 Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action.

 Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem.

title: Security Data Engineer
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.
 You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelin…

title: Staff Data Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

 As a Staff Data Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.
